The Q2 2026 adjusted EPS result exceeded consensus by 15.9 percent and rose 23.8 percent from USD 3.53 in Q2 2025, the same Zacks report said. Revenue reached USD 1.68 billion, beating the USD 1.65 billion consensus by 1.8 percent, although it declined 0.6 percent year over year.
Gartner's reported Q2 2026 revenue was USD 1,675.9 million, net income attributable to common shareholders was USD 275.5 million and operating margin was 23.0 percent. Operating cash flow reached USD 398.3 million for the quarter, giving the results a stronger cash component alongside the earnings beat.
Global contract value increased 1.7 percent year over year to USD 5.3 billion in Q2 2026, while contract value excluding the US federal government grew 3.3 percent, according to Zacks. Conferences revenue rose 15.5 percent year over year, and Gartner retained 2026 guidance of at least USD 695 million for that business.
Management also raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to at least USD 14 from USD 13.25 and lifted free cash flow guidance to at least USD 1.185 billion. Those targets contrast with the stock's market performance, where the October 2 price stood 29.22 percent below its 52-week high of USD 261.10.
